scope: Actual production mod clients and matching dedicated servers under unchanged 13 defaults and 37 catalog rows.

Each accepted profile requires independent scoped-device recomputation, fresh console response suffixes at least 60 seconds apart, double normal exit zero, PNG CRC/decompression and exact-hash manual visual review.
The historical first Fabric1.19.2 client failed before guard handshake due to a 17-character QA username; exit zero alone is not acceptance.
Formal acceptance is derived in this aggregate; original automated result formalAcceptancePassed=false is preserved.
This is not proof of real-VM rejection, all-cheat coverage, performance, online authenticated accounts, cross-loader joins, old-world migration or third-party anti-cheat integration.

NeoForge1.20.4 candidate01 on c3e742 actually joined but timed out without an accepted report. Both cleanup processes returned zero, but normal-exit flags are false and this is a retained failure. A replacement digest requires its own accepted candidate and cannot inherit old dedicated-server TCP results.
retryBoundary: Additional attempts are explicitly selected with --extra-attempt profile/candidate. Each attempt pins its own client/server JAR bytes. Old successful TCP or client evidence never transfers automatically to a new artifact digest.
